case_title: University of Mississippi Medical Center ransomware incident
scope_note: Publicly documented facts only. This file is not internal UMMC telemetry or a forensic reconstruction.

events.label: Incident detected and systems isolated
events.detail: UMMC reported irregular activity, a ransomware attack, and a decision to take affected systems offline to contain the threat. The EHR and phone systems were unavailable. Clinics and elective procedures were cancelled while hospitals and emergency departments remained open under downtime procedures.

events.label: Paper workflows support hospital care
events.detail: UMMC described switching to paper records in hospitals and emergency departments and said hospital-based care continued during the outage.

events.label: Recovery and forensics continue
events.detail: UMMC said most systems used for regular operations were back online and that a full forensic picture could take months or longer.

events.label: Public review of the incident
events.detail: UMMC stated that system monitoring detected irregular activity, that responders shut down affected systems, and that detailed forensic analysis of possible access or exfiltration was continuing. UMMC said the incident was not caused by a single user clicking a malicious email.

unresolved_public_facts: The specific initial access method has not been publicly established in the cited UMMC updates.
The April 10 update says forensic work on possible data access or exfiltration continued.
No specific threat actor is named in the cited primary UMMC statements.
